author: Stahly
description:
In this post, I'll walk you through the complete paint process for my Clanblade Exodite Dragon Master. For this one, I developed my own colour scheme to match the artwork of the Clan of the Sable Wing, matching it to the palette of my Craftworld Iyanden and Ulthwé Aeldari collection. Read on for all my paint recipes, the techniques I used, and plenty of close-up shots.

The post Colour guide: how to paint Exodites of the Clan of the Sablewing appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Colour guide: how to paint Exodites of the Clan of the Sablewing
